:::{#exm-binomial-pmf}
#### Two heads in three flips

Let $X \sim \dBinf{3, 1/2}$ be the number of heads in three flips of a fair coin.
By @eq-binom-pmf:

$$
\ba
\P(X = 2)
&= \binom{3}{2} \paren{\frac{1}{2}}^2 \paren{1 - \frac{1}{2}}^{3 - 2}
&& \text{(binomial PMF with } n = 3,\ \prob = 1/2,\ x = 2 \text{)} \\
&= \frac{3!}{2!\,1!} \paren{\frac{1}{2}}^2 \paren{\frac{1}{2}}^1
&& \text{(definition of } \tbinom{3}{2} \text{; } 1 - 1/2 = 1/2 \text{)} \\
&= 3 \cd \frac{1}{4} \cd \frac{1}{2}
&& \text{(evaluate the factorials and powers)} \\
&= \frac{3}{8}
&& \text{(multiply)}
\ea
$$

The three outcomes with two heads are $HHT$, $HTH$, and $THH$,
each with probability $1/8$.

:::
